in_text_mentions: The girl discussed here has silvery hair, eyebrows, and eyelashes (Figure 1). She was admitted at the age of five months to the hospital with fever, hepatosplenomegaly, and pancytopenia. On the discharge sheet, the evaluation included ESR, CRP, Wright, Widal, bone marrow aspiration study, and metabolic screening (MS/MS), all were normal. She was discharged with a diagnosis of a viral disease and was advised for follow up.
